# Luke Smith Morgan

Luke Smith Morgan is an Assistant Professor of Law at Campbell University's Norman A. Wiggins School of Law in Raleigh, North Carolina. He teaches Civil Procedure, Federal Courts, and Constitutional Law, and writes on the First and Second Amendments, democracy and constitutional law, constitutional coverage and doctrinal construction, and the political economy of journalism.
